requirement_text.REQ-390: Per-tenant storage-quota tracking for instance attachments, with a queryable usage figure. Filed from the GUI-review UAT run of test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/swiftroute/shipment-attach-delivery-note.yaml (PW-09). WHAT EXISTS TODAY: zero per-tenant storage accounting. upload/2 only checks @max_upload_bytes per-file. THIS REQUIREMENT builds: (1) a per-tenant storage-usage figure from instance_attachments/repository_artifacts (design decision: computed-on-read SUM vs maintained counter -- state and justify in design doc); (2) a per-tenant storage allowance (configured ceiling -- reuse TenantProvisioning or existing tenant-settings mechanism if applicable, else name a concrete default); (3) upload/2 refuses an upload that would push usage over allowance with {:error, :storage_quota_exceeded}, checked before any DB write; (4) a queryable usage function in a context module. OUT OF SCOPE: frontend display (REQ-392), route exposing it (REQ-392). ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA: (1) context-module function returns tenant's current total byte usage, correct after upload and delete in one test; (2) configured allowance exists, upload/2 refuses over-quota with distinct tag, no DB rows created for refused upload; (3) quota check and per-file check independently testable; (4) delete reflected in usage on next read; (5) mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix test pass.
